intents.reason: FD-4 of the second counter-reading of pull request 395. Under `from __future__ import annotations` the annotation `o.getenv('X')` of the nested `inner` stays a string, and nothing in the module hands an evaluator a namespace, so the alias `o` of `outer` never meets it and `os.getenv` never runs. main reads the string in the scope of `outer` and reports a read that does not happen. The head reads that scope only where `_module_hands_a_namespace` finds such a call (`_annotations_in_handed_namespaces` in scripts/core_layer_gate.py). This is the form as the test writes it; the oracle of the tool saw no read of the environment.

The CRLF form of FD-4. The import decodes a source with CRLF line ends to the same program: under Python 3.10.12 and 3.13.15 the syntax tree equals the LF form and the annotation stays the string `o.getenv('X')`, never evaluated, so the head's GREEN holds here as in the LF form. The oracle saw no read of the environment in this form.

The CR form of FD-4. A lone CR ends a line for the import as LF does: under Python 3.10.12 and 3.13.15 the syntax tree equals the LF form, the module still hands no evaluator a namespace, and the annotation is never evaluated. The oracle saw no read of the environment in this form.

The head binds a reviewed change of the guard to the source of each line it covers (F8 of the counter-reading of pull request 395, `_reviewed_changes` in scripts/core_layer_gate.py). main's `_review()` has no `source`, so the head refuses the entry as NOT_MEASURABLE, exit 2, 'every reviewed guard change needs module, form, a count of at least 1, a reason and the source of each line', and the report has no measured part. The head's copy of this test gives the review its source line and stays GREEN.

The same review entry without `source`: the head stops at it as NOT_MEASURABLE, exit 2, before it compares the form, where main says RED, exit 1. Both refuse; the head's copy of the case, with the source line, still finds the form that is gone a stale review and RED.

Again main's entry without `source`, here with a second occurrence of the reviewed form: the head refuses the entry as NOT_MEASURABLE, exit 2, where main says RED, exit 1. The head's copy, with the source line, still reports the extra occurrence as a stale review and RED.

intents.reason: `vars(json) | extra` with a parameter `extra` hands the namespace of `json` to `extra.__ror__` when the dict union declines, and that method may write into it. main counts every binary operator over a namespace as a read; the head counts it as one only when the other operand runs no code of the module (F7 of the counter-reading of pull request 395, `reads_only` in scripts/core_layer_gate.py), so here it reports 'a namespace that may be a module's, used other than by reading', a possible change of the guard. The head's tests list this input under COUNTS_ON_PURPOSE.
